Pistons 105Spurs 93

Cunningham and Jenkins end the Spurs’ streak

Final · Tue, Nov 17 · San Antonio

Detroit beat San Antonio 105–93, a 12-point road win. The Pistons move to 9–4; the Spurs fall to 12–3.
